'''Data Torrent''' is an area of [[Tethys' Deep]], [[The Black Shores]].

The Data Torrent connecting all the Nexus on this planet continuously transfers information about abnormal fluctuations caused by the Lament and Waveworn back to the Stellar Matrix. The Stellar Matrix then constructs models to predict the location and time of the next Lament. However, it must be noted that the raw energy of the Data Torrent is capable of annihilating any physical entity caught in its flow.<ref name="WGV2">Article: [[Wutherium Geographic: Lands and Waters — The Black Shores Vol. 2]]</ref>

==Points of Interest==
